why: A September 2026 arXiv preprint ('Balanced Support Calibrations for Moser's Worm Problem: Exact Certificate and Bound of Triangular Cover', arXiv:2609.04591) reports a new exact certificate/bound for a triangular universal cover, directly bearing on the minimum-area cover quantity the problem asks about; the overall problem remains open but the bound appears to have moved.
